How to read this register

Section link

All 56 complete identifiers were matched to the authenticated NHPR / ABDM facility-manager dashboard on 19 September 2026. Statuses are the exact workflow labels displayed on that date, not a live feed or a clinical-quality rating. Approved, Submitted, Query Raised, Query Resolved and Rejected are kept distinct. One masked Draft is separate. Original workbook RS flags are preserved and do not define the registry status or whether a centre is operating.

The original sources contain all 52 workbook entries and 28 distinct IDs with inspected certificate copies, reconciled to 53 identifiers. The dashboard adds Bhimavaram IN2810051839, Nizamabad IN3610023029 and Khammam IN3610023023. The 37 ACTIVE and 15 INACTIVE workbook RS values retain their original meaning-undefined status.

Similar names, separate records: Tirupati, Bhimavaram, Khammam and Nizamabad each have two IDs in the dashboard. They are kept separately, without assuming replacement, cancellation or an additional physical centre. Karkhana is the dashboard label for the workbook’s Vikrampuri identifier IN3610023703. Karimnagar’s dashboard name field displays an address. Matching here is by exact HFR identifier.

Addresses and postcode columns from the original workbook remain visible as documentary source values; this review does not silently replace them with a current-premises claim. Confirm the premises with Pinnacle when choosing a centre.

Sources: All Centers With HFR.xlsx, sheet All Centers With HFR, rows 2–53; Recognitions bundle, physical pages 67–95; NHPR facility-manager dashboard, all four pages, checked 19 September 2026. The authenticated dashboard requires account access and is not a public per-facility lookup link.
